reviews.title: There so much this case can do and it was a really good sale, even at the msrp its sill recommended.
reviews.comment:
I went with this case because it was my 2nd chose after a phantex full tower that wasn't in-stock anywhere.
This is a premium case that has 0 sharp edges.
Easy and roomy to build in. Lots of cable hooks and shelves to put cables in.
I hate RGB but the default yellow is the best of all the colors + there in no rainbow puke like every other RGB component is before settings kick in.
This was the only case in 20+ builds I have done for the past 27 years that the mother board and IO lined up over the stand offs with out having to squeeze it to the left.
You can take the front off and the front IO stays on. There is lots of USB ports in the front.
The top panel release spring only lifts up the front of the top a little and you have to dig to pop out the rest.
The top bracket for rad or fans comes out for easy installation and the fan hub is on the bracket (like the front fan hub).
All the cables related to the case reached exactly to the MB with out needing to even untie anything.
A few oddities and negativeness:
1. The back fan has really only 2 places for it directly to MB or to the top fan hub. If you use the top fan hub it can't detach and since it just has 3 slots it should really be used for the 3 top fans if your not going to put a rad up.
2. Touch controls don't respond very well. They have a weird delay or take like 5 press to work.
3. Like all cases that have a big mettle cable management bar in the middle of the case. It needs to be removed to fit GPU and plug in cables. The rubber with slits are all ways better then then this style.
4. The only unmarked cable is clearly the fan hub PWM but for some reason it doesn't show up in bios to control the case fans. Lucky its supper quiet and their pushing lot of air.
5. All the marketing and descriptions (website, amazon, newaag..) of the case fans are wrong these don't use silent wing 4 fans but they use silent wing 4 High Speed fans. 1300RPM max vs 1900RPM on the HS.
Also the black spacers are need because the fan rail blocks the edge of the larger 140 fans. The oval pattern for the screws doesn't allow for 3 140s and room to use the bottom OD bay. They only line up if you leave a small gap at the top or center of the rail then it forces the bottom fan over top of horizontal bar at the bottom.
The GPU sag bracket is oddly designed. None of the adjustment in height from the rubber top to the center bar ever fit my 3 slot 5080 PNY. I ended up just taking the top part out. Also there is no need to route the cable in side because it will bend to much and that not good with all the 12P plug problems.
The side drive bay covers were a miss opportunity to use them as 2.5 SSD holders like the phantex cases.
Manuel is kind of useless to many pictures and not enough words.
There so much this case can do and it was a really good sale, even at the msrp of 290 its sill recommended.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: A Solid Choice!
reviews.comment:
Pros:
- very solid building material
- many configuration options without getting gimmicky
- the best removable motherboard tray setup I've seen, by far!
- quiet
- attractive
- despite the many build options, easy to set up
- lots of USB ports
- nice, subtle RGB lighting
- comes with three Be Quiet fans (my favorites!)
- lots of room to build in!
- generous toolbox
Cons:
- very heavy due to solid building materials
- I would have liked to see the PSU shroud perforated to improve bottom airflow
- the GPU stand was not even close to being tall enough to support my GPU (a 2.5 slot card)!
- Can't quite do a dual GPU build; would be nice if an extra slot distance above PSU shroud (or perforated)
- price is high but appropriate for quality
- manual could have had crisper pictures
Summary:
One of my favorite cases that was just plain fun and simple to build in. Or better yet, do most of your build outside of the case due to the great removable motherboard tray. You'll build muscles moving it around, but all that material keeps things quiet. It's a real looker too. The main downside was that the bottom airflow could be better.

reviews.title: Good idea but they went toooooo cheap on manufacturing.
reviews.comment: Do not buy this case. The glass panel will shatter the first time you try to remove it, it’s way too thin, not like the previous pro model where you can actually drop it and it won’t shatter into a thousand pieces. They had a good idea but they went cheap. The phone charger never worked even if I take my iPhone out the case, it would connect at first but when checked…… NO CHARGE. Also half of the USB ports in the front can’t be connected because the wires are too short on the inside so it’s only the usb-c and 2 of the regular ones. Customer service is also garbage they will never call you back!!!!!

reviews.title: Solid High Quality and Well Engineered Full Tower Case 901 Pro - White
reviews.comment:
I just received the  new be Quiet! 901 Pro Computer case in all white from Amazon. The Corrugated box arrived in perfect condition, as did the Computer case inside. Unboxing was just like the on-line videos, and everything that was supposed to come with the case was delivered. My initial impressions of the case are that there was a lot of thought and real quality put into the design and manufacturing. The fit and the finish of this case is outstanding. Very well built and robust, and no rough edges, no bad paint, and a ton of options to configure this full tower case the way you want it. Yes, I like having the Optical Drive bay, and I will use it. The case is heavy, but that is due to having a very solid build with thick steel, and thick tempered glass side panel. Even all the wiring from the front panel is white in color. The case is easy to dis-assemble, and none of the thumb screws or phillips screws were jammed in tight, where you strip the heads of the screws to loosen the screw. I think this is one of the few modern cases with a removable motherboard tray. That is a very nice feature when you are assembling your build. Yes, some may think the cost of this case is a bit steep, but for all that you are getting, I really think this case represents real value, and something one can work with and or change for a good many years. This one is a winner. Very glad I purchased this.
Addendum: I will add that this case was a pleasure to build my new rig in. There is plenty of space for EATX Motherboards, large Video cards, and ample places for additional drives if you need them. Cable management is fairly easy with a large area in the back of the case. I went with the new DT Phanteks fans, and a 360 water cooling radiator in the front. I am using BIOS for the fan control, but nice to have the option of the case fan speed too. Very happy with this build and the new case to contain it all. Cheers!
